combats.encounter: Ooze and Limbo core at Isingue
combats.note: The resolved repeating order is Wellby, Kenzo, ooze, Delwath, Seeker. The exposed-core/minion phase and immediate falling rescue remain the same continuous encounter.

entries.summary: Acts first after the initiative-order discussion; fires a 23-to-hit arrow for 38 piercing damage. His first-round scout benefit gives the others advantage on their next turn.
Each leviathan moves 40 feet closer, ending 160 feet from the ooze.
A 600-foot-reach pseudopod hits Wellby on 26 for 22 force damage; the ooze adapts to piercing resistance after his arrow.
Uncanny Dodge halves the pseudopod’s 22 force damage to 11.

Renews one-minute Superior Defense, gaining resistance except to force, and Vital Burst: doubled speed, four staff attacks, and disadvantage on attacks against him until his next turn. Bonus-action Step of the Wind dashes into reach; he cannot carry a leviathan and takes nobody with him. All four advantaged staff attacks hit, the first critically, for 88 bludgeoning damage. The ooze shifts from piercing to bludgeoning resistance.
Each moves another 40 feet closer, bringing their two off-turn moves to 80 feet.
Attempts a corrupting/spraying touch against Kenzo; 20 misses his AC 24.

Moves 30 feet toward Kenzo and attempts engulfing; his Strength 25 succeeds. Two pseudopods produce a natural-one miss and a 28 hit for 24 force before his reaction. Its forgotten bonus-action slime ejection is resolved before the turn ends: Kenzo’s Dexterity 26 succeeds and Evasion prevents all damage.
Deflects the 24-force hit entirely and redirects 17 damage after the ooze fails a DC 20 Dexterity save.
After the ooze’s completed turn, moves another 40 feet and ends 50 feet away.

Returns from leviathan to his own form, losing its temporary hit points; charges 50 feet and applies Diaboli’s Curse as a bonus action. With first-round advantage, one attack misses on 17, another hits, and the third critically hits with a smite: 101 total slashing/smite damage. His weapon ignores slashing resistance. His first slashing wound splashes him for 6 acid, supplied retrospectively. The ooze adapts to slashing resistance.
Fires a slime glob at Delwath; his Dexterity 18 initially fails, but bardic inspiration raises it to 28, succeeding. He still takes 9 acid damage.
Uses his third off-turn move to close to 10 feet from the ooze.
Casts fourth-level Rune of Psychic Disruption, forcing a DC 20 Intelligence save; the ooze spends a legendary resistance. Moves onto and into the ooze in leviathan form.
Two arrows hit for 40 and 12 piercing damage; the ooze shifts from slashing to piercing resistance at the end of his turn.
Attacks Delwath with a pseudopod; the final 24-to-hit result is used without the accidentally rolled advantage.
Casts Shield, causing the 24-to-hit pseudopod to miss.
Strength 21 lets him swim 60 feet through the piercing-resistant ooze as difficult terrain; corrected from an initial 40 feet, leaving 140 feet to the sinkhole.

Without advantage, makes two staff attacks, both hits and one critical, and three unarmed strikes, two hits and a 19 miss. Damage is 24 + 18 + 14. The ooze hardens into bludgeoning resistance, tightening the mesh around Seeker.
Corrupting touch hits Kenzo on a thirty-something for 23 poison damage, subject to his resistance; its poisoned condition cannot affect him.
Deflects all corrupting-touch damage; the ooze succeeds on the DC 20 rebound save, so no redirected damage is resolved.
Strength 22 forces a way through the hardened ooze, moving 30 feet in twice-difficult terrain.

Moves 30 feet forward and engulfs Kenzo and Delwath after failed Strength saves (Kenzo 21 and a failed ki reroll). They are restrained, suffocating, carried with it and covered from outside effects. Its forgotten bonus-action acid ejection at Wellby is resolved retrospectively on this turn: Dexterity 20 fails, taking 57 acid damage and being pulled 60 feet closer, to a corrected 80 feet away, without restraint.

Starts engulfed and takes 22 force damage. Uses quickened bonus-action transformation into a cloud of tiny bugs, immune to restraint for his turn, and escapes to 20 feet away. Three attacks hit (24, 22 and a higher roll) for 32 + 15 + 18 damage, adding a 30-damage smite. The ooze adapts to slashing resistance.
Crushes the occupants: Seeker’s Strength 23 succeeds for 15 force damage; Kenzo’s 17 and unsuccessful reroll fail for 31 force.
A natural-one Strength check fails to advance through the ooze.

Repeats Psychic Disruption; the initially announced failed Intelligence save is corrected to a successful 21 against a stated DC 19, so no legendary resistance is spent. Strength 16 permits another 60 feet of movement, leaving 50 feet to the sinkhole. Passive start-of-turn force damage is later reversed because leviathan is immune to restraint.
Pseudopod hits Delwath on 30 for 21 force damage.
Retreats to 170 feet from the ooze; two arrows hit for 42 and 9 piercing damage, shifting it to piercing resistance.
With Wellby out of glob range, targets Delwath instead. His Dexterity save fails after the bug-cloud immunity has expired; he takes 16 acid damage and is engulfed again.
Strength 24 succeeds, moving 60 feet: reaches the sinkhole and descends 10 feet, leaving 30 feet to its bottom.

Starts restrained inside and takes 28 force damage. Drinks a potion of speed as his bonus action. Uses the Haste action to escape: Strength 16 fails, ki reroll 25 succeeds. Makes two regular staff attacks while leaving, one hit for 23 damage and a 21 miss; the ooze is bloodied by this hit. Retreats 100 feet, with the stated aim of remaining 70 feet away after the ooze advances.

Moves 30 feet carrying the already-engulfed Delwath. Grasping glob catches Kenzo: Dexterity 21 fails and reroll 16 also fails, dealing 13 acid reduced to 6 and pulling him inside, restrained. Pseudopod hits Wellby on 23 for 26 force before his reaction. Slime ejection does not recharge.
Uncanny Dodge reduces 26 force damage from the pseudopod to 13.
Bonus-action Misty Step escapes the ooze to at least 20 feet away. First two attacks miss on 19 and 20; uses his automatic-hit ability on the third and smites for 28 + 11 damage.
Crushes Kenzo and Seeker: Kenzo fails on Strength 18 for 26 force damage; Seeker succeeds on 25 for 13.
Strength 15 fails to move the last 30 feet toward the core.
Strength 24 reaches the ten-foot dense shell at the sinkhole bottom. His slam and tail both connect but deal no damage: the Limbo fragment is currently immune to every damage type except thunder.

Crushes again. Seeker rolls Strength with disadvantage because he is beside the heart, fails on 17 and takes 26 force; Kenzo also takes 26 force. Seeker succeeds on the required concentration save and retains Shapechange.
Fires for 46 piercing damage, drinks a healing potion (healing amount unstated) and flies 90 feet upward. The ooze shifts to piercing resistance.
Pseudopod hits Wellby on 19 for 16 force damage.

Takes 24 force damage while engulfed. Haste-action escape and ki reroll fail, the latter on 18. Makes five attacks with disadvantage; only the first hits for 24 damage. His end-of-turn Strength escape also fails.

Advances 30 feet and engulfs Delwath; DC 23 Strength is stated, and he accepts the failed escape situation. Two pseudopods hit Wellby on 21 and thirty-something for 19 and 22 force. Slime ejection again fails to recharge.
Uncanny Dodge halves the second 22-force hit to 11, taking 30 total across the two pseudopods.
Attempts a slam against the ooze rather than the unchanged core; a roll of three misses.

Takes 22 force at the start. Quickened Scatter teleports Kenzo and himself free, to 70 and 20 feet away respectively. Three attacks hit, corrected first result 22, second 23 and a critical third with his final smite, for 99 + 15 + 18 damage; the ooze falls below a quarter. Acid retaliation deals 5. Runs to 80 feet away without leaving the ooze’s 600-foot reach.
Grasping glob catches Delwath on a failed Dexterity save (natural one), deals 21 acid and engulfs him again.
Embraces the ten-foot Limbo core and tries to imagine it into vanishing feathers. Intelligence 15 does nothing; his heroic reroll is worse and also fails.

Crushes Seeker at the heart with a disadvantaged Strength save; he fails. Delwath is also engulfed and required to save. The initial 22-force announcement is corrected to 21 to each; Delwath reports 20 hit points remaining.
Two arrows hit for 33 and 9 piercing damage, 42 total; flies another 90 feet upward. The ooze adapts to piercing.
Critical pseudopod hits Wellby. The damage calculation is revised during Uncanny Dodge, with 42 the final announced force amount.
Uses Uncanny Dodge and remains conscious; his final correction is two hit points, superseding the DM’s one-hit-point remark.

Flies in and back out, ending 70 feet away. Makes three staff attacks, two hits and a 20 miss, and three unarmed strikes, one critical, one hit and one miss. Deals 42 + 18 + 14 damage; the ooze shifts to bludgeoning resistance.

Advances 30 feet but cannot engulf Kenzo. Two pseudopods hit on 26 and 24: the first deals 36 force, triggering Kenzo’s once-only recovery to 87 hit points; the second would deal 21 force before his reaction.
Deflects the second hit to zero; the ooze fails its DC 20 Dexterity save and takes 14 redirected damage.

Takes 14 force while engulfed, then bonus-action Misty Steps free and attacks three times: one hit for 18 damage and two natural-one misses. The proposed retrospective automatic hit is not allowed. The ooze shifts to slashing resistance.
Pseudopod hits Delwath on 29 for 30 force damage after his attempted blessing dodge fails; he falls unconscious.
Tries the Tanshi blessing to dodge the hit automatically, needing four or higher, but rolls another one; the hit stands.
Slam hits on 25 and tail misses on 19 against the ooze. The table reports 12 damage, and it shifts to bludgeoning resistance.
entries.note: The DM says damage will be halved while describing slashing resistance; the transcript does not clearly state whether the reported 12 is before or after that reduction.

entries.summary: Crushes Seeker near the core: disadvantaged Strength 10 fails, dealing 20 force damage.

Uses an arrow of seeking, critically hitting for a stated 67 damage. A second arrow hits for 9; he calls the combined total 78. The ooze thins and decoheres around the core. Wellby flies down and waits on the ground.
entries.note: The stated total 78 conflicts with 67 + 9 = 76; neither component nor the table’s total is silently changed.

entries.summary: Pseudopod strikes Wellby for 27 force damage, knocking him unconscious on the ground.

Flies into the ooze, ending about 60 feet from the core. Uses one Haste staff attack for 12 + 9 damage; although three hits including a critical were initially rolled, only this first attack resolves before the phase change. The ooze sheds minions and exposes the still thunder-only core, loses engulfing and ceases passive crushing. Kenzo uses a bonus-action dash back and his regular action to administer Delwath’s greater healing potion, restoring 13 hit points.

Commands five minions to attack Kenzo, missing on 18. Two pseudopods roll 27 and 23, one hitting for 24 force before Kenzo’s reaction. Slime ejection does not recharge; the other minion groups have no standing target and do not act.
Deflects the 24-force hit and tries to redirect it; the returned damage splashes harmlessly on the ooze.
Uses first-level Healing Word to restore Wellby to 7 hit points. Uses his action to regain a warlock spell slot and moves 60 feet away; he makes no attack.
Targets Kenzo, the last attacker, with a pseudopod: a 19 on the die hits for 23 force damage.

Ends Shapechange and stays beside the core. Uses the glove to convert seventh-level Chain Lightning to thunder, DC 19 Dexterity. The core uses a legendary resistance to save; half damage and thunder vulnerability cancel, so it takes 36 and develops small cracks. Gives Kenzo bardic inspiration as his bonus action.
Critical pseudopod hits Seeker in his own form for the final stated 36 force damage.
Shoots a minion with sneak-attack support from the nearby allies; the low roll still hits its AC 16, with 32 damage reported, and the arrow strikes one slime down.
Retaliates against Wellby for hitting its minion. A stated roll of 20 hits for 25 damage; Wellby declines an ineffectual damage-halving reaction and falls unconscious again.

Moves his full 140 feet to the core. Uses his Haste action to imagine the Limbo fragment as fragile glass: natural 20 Intelligence succeeds without spending bardic inspiration, making it vulnerable to bludgeoning. Three bonus-action unarmed strikes yield one hit and two misses (including a natural one), with 13 damage rolled. Two staff attacks hit for 35 total rolled damage. Bludgeoning vulnerability applies; the third landed blow shatters the core.
Opportunity attack during Kenzo’s approach deals 16 piercing reduced by resistance to 8. He preserves his reaction rather than deflecting.

Implodes, dealing 21 force damage each to Kenzo and Seeker and throwing both 1,000 feet upward. Wellby suffers one failed death save; Delwath is out of range. The ooze and minions solidify into crystal. Flying Kenzo takes no falling damage; Seeker still needs a way down.
Uses his next turn to wake Wellby with 34 healing; Wellby is conscious to witness Seeker’s rescue.
Seeker animates Ladder, which catches him and carries him gently to the ground, preventing the otherwise threatened 1,000-foot fall.
entries.note: The successful rescue is narrated after Delwath’s turn; the earlier proposal is cited as setup, not counted as an extra completed action.

ending.summary: Kenzo changes the core to glass and smashes it. The ooze and minions crystallize and the ash begins settling. Delwath and Wellby survive after healing; Kenzo flies safely and animated Ladder saves Seeker from the fall.
